In article <D0w59...@cs.dal.ca>,
Joseph William Dixon <aa...@cfn.cs.dal.ca> wrote:
> I have a friend who believes that Eagle's Sight (superior) means that
>the action it's reacting against is automatically blocked. Is he right,
>or does it actually just allow you to try and block an action that you
>normally couldn't? [like a Direct action against another Methusela, or
>the action of someone who isn't your prey or predator]

It just allows you to block directed actions assuming your intercept >=
stealth of said action. Same thing for Anneke.

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Superior Eagle's Sight simply allows the vampire to block the action even
if that player couldn't have normally tried to. It must still overcome
any stealth, not be Blood Bound to the acting vampire, etc.
